briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent arms race with o4 and Grok-3 launches

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier remains intensely competitive with new model releases accelerating capability gains across labs. Regulatory scrutiny is mounting amid rising security incidents in deployed systems. DialectForge emerges as a key protocol innovation for secure multi-agent ecosystems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning benchmarks topping 92% on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI's Grok-3 entered testing, while DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on Chinese frontier performance. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights under new licensing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Multiple exploits hit enterprise chat agents this week. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with new patents filed for automotive CAN bus and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 500k units quarterly. Microsoft and Google expanded data center builds in Texas and Arizona with 200MW+ clusters dedicated to AI training.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level security like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
